Hello! I’m Aditya, a passionate developer who loves using technology to solve real-world problems and drive meaningful impact.

Currently, I’m building in Generative AI and full-stack development. Over the past few years, I’ve worked on several personal and freelance projects that served real users. Along the way, I’ve also won a few hackathons and bounties.

Beyond the code, I’ve taken initiative in leadership roles , leading both the Entrepreneurship Cell and Tech Club at my college, where I fostered innovation and collaboration.
